–AGENDA–
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  BUILDING AND FIRE BOARD OF APPEALS

  CITY OF GLENDALE, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  MSB Room 105, 633 E. Broadway, Glendale, CA 91206

 Welcome to the regular meeting of the Building and Fire Board of Appeals. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout
 the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by calling
 (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Municipal Services Building, Room 105.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon
 request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign
 language translation and Braille transcription services.

 If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Community Development Department at (818) 548-2140
 during regular business hours.

  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 17, 2019 AT 2:00 P.M.
1.  ROLL CALL: Tatoulian, Lee, Keshishian, Aharonian, Hanessian

2.  REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
  The agenda for this meeting will be posted on Thursday, April 11, 2019, on the bulletin board
  outside City Hall and on the City’s web site.

3.  PRESENTATIONS AND COMMENDATIONS

   Building & Safety Month Events
   Changes in the Fire Prevention Bureau organization.
   2020 Building Code Process

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
   February 20, 2019

5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is limited to 5 minutes.
  The Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

6.  OLD BUSINESS
  NONE

BUILDING & FIRE BOARD OF APPEALS
  MEETING MINUTES
  4/17/2019

The Building and Fire Board of Appeals meeting convened at 2:08 p.m. in the MSB
Room 105, with Chairman Erik Keshishian presiding.

  I.  ROLL CALL
  PRESENT:  Aharonian, Keshishian, Lee, Hanessian
  ABSENT:  Tatoulian

  Staff Members Present:
  Jan Bear, Building Official
  Kirsten Billing, Recording Secretary
  Jeff Ragusa, Fire Battalion Chief
  Joseph Rodarte, Permit Services Administrator

  II.  PRESENTATIONS & COMMENDATIONS
   Building Official Jan Bear and Permit Services Administrator Joseph
  Rodarte discussed Building & Safety Month Events for the month of
  May.
   Fire Battalion Chief Jeff Ragusa discussed changes in the Fire
  Prevention Bureau organization.
   Building Official Jan Bear discussed the 2020 Building Code Process.
  III.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETING –
  February 20, 2019

  Board member Ara Aharonian made a motion that the minutes be approved as
  submitted, seconded by board member Steven Lee.
